Bitches become sexually mature when they have their first heat period, usu-

Dams should deliver at home in familiar surroundings where they are at ease.
The best place to care for newborn puppies is in a whelping box. The box

first 24 hours. Treating of delayed milk letdown is described on page 486.
Once the milk does comes down, the puppies begin to nurse and the bond is

enzymes to detoxify and eliminate these drugs. This can lead to the accumu-

damage in a medium-size dog. Symptoms develop quickly and include abdom-
